title: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026
tagline: Shop local makers, unique gifts, treats, and more — and support Thunder Hill Elementary.
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Holiday Market is Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11 AM–3 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Shop local makers and small businesses — vendor spaces available now.
flyer_alt: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026 flyer — Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School. Vendor registration: $30 early bird until November 1, $40 from November 2 to 18, per 8 by 6 foot space.
about: Join us for a festive day of shopping, community, and small businesses! The THES PTA Holiday Market brings local artisans, crafters, bakers, and small businesses together under one roof — the perfect place to find one-of-a-kind holiday gifts while supporting our school.
Vendor fees go directly to the Thunder Hill Elementary PTA, helping fund programs for our students and teachers.

sections.heading: What You'll Find
items: Handmade and unique gifts from local makers
Art, jewelry, and holiday décor
Baked goods, treats, food, and beverages
Direct-sales favorites and small businesses from our community

sections.heading: Become a Vendor
items: Early bird: $30 per 8' × 6' space, through November 1
Standard: $40 per 8' × 6' space, November 2 – November 18
Only 40 spaces available — first come, first served
The first 20 vendors to register get a yard sign to advertise the market
You keep 100% of your sales — vendor fees go to the THES PTA
Vendors bring their own tables, chairs, and extension cords (the PTA can't supply these)
Vendor setup 9:30 – 11:00 AM · cleanup 3:00 – 4:00 PM
sections.note: We're looking for: Artists & artisans, crafters & makers, bakers, food & beverage vendors and food trucks, and direct-sales representatives (Scentsy, Tastefully Simple, Pampered Chef, Tupperware, Nailed It, and more).

title: THES PTA Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat 2026
tagline: An evening of fall fun, food trucks, games, and trick-or-treating for the whole family.
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat is Friday, October 30, 2026, 5–8 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Free for families — rain date Sunday, November 1, 1–4 PM.
flyer_alt: THES PTA Fall Fest and Trunk or Treat flyer — Friday, October 30, 5 to 8 PM. Fall Fest 5 to 6:30 PM, Trunk or Treat 6:30 to 8 PM, rain date November 1, 1 to 4 PM. Music, festive fall activities, games, food trucks, raffles, contests, and more. Free THES PTA event; children must be accompanied by an adult.
about: Join us for a free evening of fall fun for the whole Thunder Hill family! Fall Fest kicks things off with music, games, and festive activities, followed by Trunk or Treat, where families decorate their cars and hand out treats in the school parking lot.
This is a free THES PTA event — everyone is welcome.

sections.heading: What to Expect
items: Fall Fest, 5:00 – 6:30 PM: music, festive fall activities, games, and contests
Food and drink vendors, raffles, and much more
Trunk or Treat, 6:30 – 8:00 PM
Rain date: Sunday, November 1, 1:00 – 4:00 PM

sections.heading: Food & Drink Vendors
items: Say Squeeze: lemonade, limeade, Brazilian lemonade, tea, and more
The Mercenary Chef: delicious food options for the whole family
Alyssa's Sweets & Treats: pastries, desserts, cakes, and more

sections.heading: Good to Know
items: Children must be accompanied by an adult
Parking will be limited
No scary or gory costumes, and no face mask coverings
Donate candy for Trunk or Treat October 12 – 30 in the Candy Robot box in the THES Main Office

sections.heading: Trunk Decorating Contest
items: Get creative and decorate your vehicle for the Trunk or Treat contest
Categories: Cutest, Most Creative, Funniest, and Best Overall
Winners receive a trophy
Attendees vote on their phones with a virtual ballot; QR codes will be posted around the event

sections.heading: Volunteer or Host a Trunk
items: Help run Fall Fest activities
Sign up your vehicle to decorate a trunk and hand out treats

extra_flyers.alt: Fall Fest and Trunk or Treat food and drink vendors flyer: Say Squeeze (lemonade, limeade, Brazilian lemonade, tea and more), The Mercenary Chef (food options for the whole family), and Alyssa's Sweets & Treats (pastries, desserts, cakes and more). Friday, October 30, 2026, 5 to 8 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School.

THES PTA Fall Fest and Trunk or Treat Decorating Contest flyer: get creative and decorate your vehicle for the Trunk or Treat contest. Categories: Cutest, Most Creative, Funniest, and Best Overall. Winners receive a trophy. Attendees vote with a phone-friendly virtual ballot; QR codes will be posted around the event. Friday, October 30, 2026 — Fall Fest 5:00 to 6:30 PM, Trunk or Treat 6:30 to 8:00 PM.

title: THES Veterans Day Celebration 2026
tagline: Help us honor the veterans and military family members in our Thunder Hill community.
summary: Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County) honors its veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Submit a family member for the slideshow and classroom visits by October 25.
flyer_alt: Veterans Day at THES flyer — Wednesday, November 11, 2026. THES will have a celebration for all veteran families, with a photo slideshow and classroom visits. To include a veteran or military family member, complete the Veterans/Military Submission form (QR code on the flyer) by October 25th. If you submitted your information last year, you do not need to submit it again. Questions: meagan_lesinski@hcpss.org.
about: Thunder Hill Elementary School will celebrate and honor our veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
Families are invited to help us recognize the veterans and military family members in our community through our Veterans Day slideshow and classroom visits.

sections.heading: How to Take Part
items: Photo slideshow: share a photo of your veteran or military family member to include in our school slideshow
Classroom visit: veterans and military family members are welcome to visit classrooms, if available
Honor & celebrate: help us recognize the brave people in our THES community

sections.heading: Submit a Family Member
items: Complete the Veterans/Military Submission Form by October 25
Scan the QR code on the flyer below to open the form
Submitted your information last year? You don't need to submit it again

title: THES PTA Kindergarten Play Date 2026
tagline: Play on the playground and meet other kindergarten families!
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Kindergarten Play Date is Saturday, October 10, 2026, 11 AM–12 PM on the Thunder Hill Elementary School playground in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Kindergarten students and families can play, connect, and make new friends.
flyer_alt: THES PTA Kindergarten Play Date flyer — Saturday, October 10, 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Thunder Hill Elementary School playground. Play on the playground and meet other kindergarten families: a fun opportunity for our kindergarten students and families to play, connect, and make new friends.
about: Come join us for a Kindergarten Play Date at the school playground! It's a fun and relaxed opportunity for our kindergarten students and families to play, connect, meet new friends, and get to know one another.

sections.heading: What to Expect
items: Play on the school playground
Meet other kindergarten families
A relaxed hour to connect and make new friends

title: THES PTA Candy-Bot 3000 Candy Drive 2026
tagline: Feed the Candy-Bot! Drop off individually wrapped candy at the THES front office, October 12–30, for Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat.
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Candy-Bot 3000 candy drive runs October 12–30, 2026 at Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Drop off individually wrapped candy at the front office to help stock the PTA's Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat on October 30.
location_name: Thunder Hill Elementary School — Front Office
flyer_alt: THES PTA Candy-Bot 3000 flyer: candy donations needed for THES PTA Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat. Collection dates October 12 to 30. Where: THES front office. What to donate: individually wrapped candy. Students and families can drop off candy donations directly at the front office and help make Trunk or Treat extra sweet for our Thunderbirds. Thank you for your donations!
about: Please feed the Candy-Bot 3000! The THES PTA is collecting candy for Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat on Friday, October 30.
Students and families can drop off candy donations directly at the front office and help us make Trunk or Treat extra sweet for our Thunderbirds. Thank you for your donations!

sections.heading: How to Donate
items: Collection dates: October 12–30
Where: the Candy-Bot 3000 in the THES front office
What to donate: individually wrapped candy
